analysis.reasonEn: RSI is exiting oversold territory (32.9→40.1), but ADX remains in early trend formation at 23.0, lacking directional conviction. MACD histogram is improving (-3201.4245 → 314.0351) but not yet positive, failing to signal a buy. The 5-day losing streak (-3.03%, -1.80%) continues the downtrend. At 28.8% of the 52-week low, rebound potential exists, but the attempt at a Higher Low (5-day low higher than 20-day low) warrants a wait-and-see approach for further confirmation.
